保留四个 3、目标 Dynkin 标签 (2,1)、左到右和输入路径 0，点击计: Keep all four inputs at 3, the target Dynkin label (2,1), left-to-right recoupling, and input path 0. Run the calculation and record the exact probabilities by right-tree path index. Any path missing from the nonzero-channel table has probability 0.
按右树第一中间表示 G 合并概率。把 G=6 和 G=3̄ 的概率各乘本例给出的: Group the probabilities by the first right-tree intermediate irrep G. Weight the O/κ eigenvalues given in the example by the probabilities of G=6 and G=3̄, then sum to obtain the scaled mean. Repeat with the squared eigenvalues and subtract the square of the scaled mean to obtain the variance divided by κ².

Group the exact probabilities by the first right-tree intermediate irrep G, summing over all paths with G=8. In the R matrix, check the overlap between left path 7 and right path 7.
